# Emeği geçenler / Credits

## Pixel art
**“Farm RPG – Tiny Asset Pack (All in One)”** by **EmanuelleDev** — https://emanuelledev.itch.io

Used under the pack's licence (use in commercial/non-commercial projects allowed, modification allowed; the assets
may not be resold or redistributed, even modified; credit required). Adapted for terrain and shorelines, trees and
resource nodes, crops, item icons, furniture/work benches, several animals and the player character. The pack itself
is not included in this repository (see `tools/farmpack/README.md`).

All other art (points of interest, houses, boats, most sea creatures, scene illustrations, UI symbols and the sprites
listed as "not used" in `tools/farmpack/README.md`) is drawn by the project's own procedural generator
(`tools/assetgen/`).

## Sound
All 63 sound cues are original Web Audio syntheses (`src/audio/SynthBank.js`).
